meta.dial_vintage: rd2_fragility.parquet 10d MA of 63d, current-weights recompute before 2026-07-02, PIT append after; dial_pit = sibling PIT vintage-lagged series (cross_strategy_regime_pit_dial.parquet) where available
meta.selection_rule: N>=60, strictly monotone tercile avgR, |episode-cluster t|>=2, LOYO sign agreement >=70% over >=5 years, |top-bottom avgR|>=0.30
meta.episode_def: same-strategy signals chained while consecutive gaps <= 5 trading days

olv_recency_ladder.note: rung = prior FILLED OLV signals in the ticker inside 21 td (ledger proxy for the live mask count; understates the true count). Live mults 0.5/0.7/1.0.

olv_earnings_override.note: OLV override: -10..0 td to earnings -> 10 bps nominal (from 35).

stos_earnings_override.note: St OS Sznl override: -5..-1 td -> 6 bps nominal (from 40).

gap_derate|Monday Dip.note: live derate (Monday Dip, MonFri only): T+1 open > close + 0.25 ATR -> 0.5x

gap_derate|SPY QQQ MonFri Reversion.note: live derate (Monday Dip, MonFri only): T+1 open > close + 0.25 ATR -> 0.5x

gap_derate|Weak Close Decent Sznls.note: live derate (Monday Dip, MonFri only): T+1 open > close + 0.25 ATR -> 0.5x

gap_derate|Indices Oversold Bounce.note: live derate (Monday Dip, MonFri only): T+1 open > close + 0.25 ATR -> 0.5x

bear_same_day_derate.note: same_day_signal_derate 0.10/floor 0.30 on the day's signal count (staged, not filled; ledger count is fills)

R7_family_pullback.rule: single-stock dip-buys: SPY within 2% of 252d high -> 0.5x

R8_reference_SPY QQQ MonFri Reversion.rule: SPY QQQ MonFri Reversion gap-up derate (live)

candidates.name: OVS short-window rank extremity (bottom cut)
candidates.mechanism: larger prior overbought move -> larger 2-day reversal (short-term reversal literature: reversal scales with the prior move); holds in both tiers, both paths, all four eras

candidates.name: 52wh Breakout in very quiet SPY tape
candidates.mechanism: vol clustering + leverage effect: a 63d momentum hold opened at a realized-vol trough spans a likely vol expansion, which for equities is down-skewed

candidates.name: LT Trend ST OS in a quiet book
candidates.mechanism: signal flow marks market dislocation days; a 1-day single-stock dip on a quiet book is idiosyncratic (no market bounce to ride)

candidates.name: Single-stock dip-buys with SPY within 2% of its 252d high
candidates.strategy: family: OLV, LT Trend, WCDS, Monday Dip, St OS Sznl
candidates.mechanism: beta channel: SPY 10d forward return after the signal is ~+1.6% when off-high vs ~0% near-high (index pullbacks in uptrends recover); single-stock dips near index highs are idiosyncratic. 4 of 5 strategies agree; OLV alone does not walk forward
candidates.verdict: propose 0.5x family band, prereg PIT check on SPY basis

candidates.name: WCDS gap-up derate extension
candidates.mechanism: same as the live Monday Dip / MonFri derate: the bounce plays out at the open and the Open-0.25 ATR limit fills worse

candidates.name: OLV post-earnings window
candidates.mechanism: post-earnings-announcement drift: an oversold low-volume name inside a month of a print is drifting on news, not washing out

candidates.name: WCDS signal-day move size
candidates.mechanism: a weak close on a small move is drift, on a large move is capitulation
